title: Velvet Skipway
description: A melody-led 2-step garage roller at 133 BPM: interlocking felt-piano stabs and a choked square arp skip over a broken 808 kick and shuffled hats, with a chopped diva vocal hook and a sidechained pad pumping under the groove. It keeps evolving, the progression shifting and the filter opening as new layers fold in and out.
code:
setcpm(133/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.9),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1).euclid(5,8).hpf(7000),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").gain(0.6).lpf(1400).room(0.3).attack(0.01).release(0.4)

    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.98).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 1 2>")),
